newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end up despite financial firm worries.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end up despite financial firm worries.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately higher on Friday, as lingering worries over the financial health of some companies prompted investors to actively seek high-technology issues that are backed by strong earnings, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average gained 120.71 points or 0.61 percent to close at 19,875.49. Its September Nikkei futures rose 60 points to 19,840.
"Worries over financially weak companies forced investors to hunt for issues backed by healthy earnings," said Kenji Karikomi, deputy general manager at Daiwa Securities Co Ltd.
